# Population Cleaning Script

## Import Raw Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from utils import db_cleaning_utils

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
txt_path = data_dir / "population" / "us.1990_2024.20ages.adjusted.txt"
```

```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_fwf(txt_path, header = None, names=['FIPS_info', 'other_info'])
```

## Separate Into Readable Columns

### Year

```{python}
df_raw['year'] = df_raw['FIPS_info'].str[:4].astype(int)
```

```{python}
# remove years outside of analysis window
df_raw = df_raw[df_raw['year'] > 2000]
df_raw = df_raw[df_raw['year'] < 2023]
```

### FIPS

```{python}
df_raw['county_id'] = df_raw['FIPS_info'].str[-5:]
```

### Population

```{python}
df_raw['population'] = df_raw['other_info'].astype(str).str[-8:].astype(int)
```

## Deal with combined city-counties

```{python}
# convert VA independent cities to parent county and combine values
city_to_parent_county = {
    '51510': '51013',
    '51515': '51019',
    '51520': '51191',
    '51530': '51163',
    '51540': '51003',
    '51550': '51131',
    '51570': '51053',
    '51580': '51005',
    '51590': '51143',
    '51595': '51081',
    '51600': '51059',
    '51610': '51059',
    '51620': '51175',
    '51630': '51177',
    '51640': '51035',
    '51650': '51095',
    '51660': '51165',
    '51670': '51149',
    '51678': '51163',
    '51680': '51031',
    '51683': '51153',
    '51685': '51153',
    '51690': '51089',
    '51700': '51095',
    '51710': '51095',
    '51720': '51195',
    '51730': '51053',
    '51735': '51199',
    '51740': '51095',
    '51750': '51121',
    '51760': '51087',
    '51770': '51161',
    '51775': '51161',
    '51790': '51015',
    '51800': '51131',
    '51810': '51131',
    '51820': '51015',
    '51830': '51095',
    '51840': '51069'
}

def roll_up_va_cities_to_county(df):
    df["county_id"] = df["county_id"].replace(city_to_parent_county)
    return df

df_raw = roll_up_va_cities_to_county(df_raw)
```

```{python}
# Assigned combined Bedford county VA and Bedford city to Bedford county id
df_raw.loc[df_raw["county_id"] == "51917", "county_id"] = "51019"

# remapping Oglala Lakota County code to fips standard
df_raw.loc[df_raw["county_id"] == "46113", "county_id"] = "46102"
```


## Sum By Column

```{python}
df_final = df_raw.groupby(['year', 'county_id'], as_index = False)['population'].sum()
```

```{python}
# keep only osbservations which are in the lower 48 states and DC
df_final = db_cleaning_utils.remove_rows_not_in_mainland_states(df_final, "county_id")
```

## Update child counties to use parent

```{python}
df_final = db_cleaning_utils.child_to_parent_county(
    df_final, 
    map_dict = {'46113': '46102', '12025': '12086', '24510': '24005', '29510': '29189', '32510': '32005', '46113': '46102'}
    )
```

# Export to database

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
df_final.to_sql(
    "population",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
